# Avalin Laboratories Pvt Ltd

> Corporate & Pharmaceutical Portfolio Information

Avalin Laboratories Pvt Ltd is an Indian pharmaceutical marketing company headquartered in Guwahati, Assam. The company markets prescription (Rx) and over-the-counter (OTC) pharmaceutical products manufactured in compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and national regulatory standards.

- Corporate Headquarters: ASEB Road, Opp. ASTC Workshop, Ulubari, Guwahati, Assam 781007, India
- Website: https://avalinlaboratories.com
- Primary Inquiries: avalin.laboratories@gmail.com
- Pharmacovigilance & Safety Reporting: avalin.laboratories@gmail.com
- FSSAI Registration: 10324025000034

## Core Therapeutic Areas & Marketed Products

### 1. Vitamins, Minerals & Nutrition
- **Lisium K2 Soft Gelatin Capsule** (Rx): Calcium Citrate Malate 250 mg, Calcitriol 0.25 mcg, Vitamin K2-7 50 mcg, Methylcobalamin 750 mcg, L-Methylfolate 400 mcg, Zinc 7.5 mg, Magnesium 50 mg. Used in osteoporosis, osteomalacia, post-menopausal bone health.
- **Lisium Tablet** (Rx): Calcium Citrate Malate 1000 mg, Vitamin D3 200 IU, Folic Acid 50 mcg. Used in calcium deficiency, bone fractures, pregnancy/lactation nutritional support.
- **Avaco 60K Softgel Capsule** (Rx): Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3) 60,000 IU. Used in severe Vitamin D deficiency, bone mineralization disorders, tetany.
- **Vitacomin Capsule** (OTC): Balanced daily multivitamin and mineral supplement supporting cellular energy, immune defense, and general vitality.

### 2. Digestive & Gastrointestinal Health
- **Adezyme Syrup** (OTC): Fungal Diastase (1:1200) 50 mg + Pepsin (1:3000) 10 mg per 5 ml. Indicated for digestive insufficiency, dyspepsia, post-prandial fullness, and flatulence.
- **Emopraz-D Capsule SR** (Rx): Esomeprazole 40 mg (EC) + Domperidone 30 mg (SR). Used for gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcer disease, and acid reflux with nausea.
- **Rezopraz D Capsule SR** (Rx): Rabeprazole Sodium 20 mg (EC) + Domperidone 30 mg (SR). Indicated for erosive GERD, Zollinger-Ellison syndrome, and hyperacidity associated with dysmotility.

### 3. Anti-Infective & Critical Care Antibiotics
- **Niltaz 4.5 Injection** (Rx): Piperacillin 4000 mg + Tazobactam 500 mg. Hospital-grade intravenous broad-spectrum antipseudomonal penicillin + beta-lactamase inhibitor for severe nosocomial infections, intra-abdominal sepsis, and lower respiratory tract infections.
- **Nilaxone-S Injection** (Rx): Ceftriaxone 1000 mg + Sulbactam 500 mg. Broad-spectrum third-generation cephalosporin + beta-lactamase inhibitor for surgical prophylaxis, urinary tract infections, and meningitis.

### 4. Pain Management & Neuro-CNS
- **XLP IV Infusion** (Rx): Paracetamol 1000 mg per 100 ml IV infusion. Rapid-onset antipyretic and analgesic for moderate-to-severe post-operative pain and pyrexia in hospital wards and ICUs.
- **Neuron-M Tablet** (Rx): Pregabalin 75 mg + Methylcobalamin 750 mcg. Indicated for diabetic peripheral neuropathy, post-herpetic neuralgia, and nerve regeneration.

### 5. Hepatoprotective
- **Ursentin 300 Tablet** (Rx): Ursodeoxycholic Acid (UDCA) 300 mg. Dissolution of radiolucent gallstones, primary biliary cholangitis, and non-alcoholic fatty liver conditions.

### 6. Probiotics & Gut Flora
- **Provilin Capsule** (Rx): Multi-strain probiotic and prebiotic formulation for antibiotic-associated diarrhea, inflammatory gut disorders, and intestinal microflora restoration.

## Compliance and Safe Use Policy
All prescription medications listed must be dispensed only upon the prescription of a registered medical practitioner. Avalin Laboratories does not sell medicines directly to consumers online. For institutional rate contracts, distributor inquiries, or pharmacovigilance notifications, contact the company directly via https://avalinlaboratories.com/reach-us.
